responseCommitment.title: Our Response Commitment
responseCommitment.text: We aim to respond to all inquiries within 24 hours. Whether you need a quotation, project consultation, or additional information, our team is ready to assist you with professionalism and efficiency.

items.question: How can I request a quotation?
items.answer: Simply fill out the contact form or call us directly. We'll prepare a tailored quotation based on your requirements.

items.question: Do you work outside Juba?
items.answer: Yes, we operate across all ten states of South Sudan and can mobilise teams nationwide.

items.question: Can you work with NGOs and UN agencies?
items.answer: Absolutely. We are registered with UNGM and have extensive experience serving humanitarian and development organisations.

items.question: How long does it take to receive a response?
items.answer: We respond to most inquiries within a few hours during business hours, and within 24 hours at the latest.

items.question: Can I schedule a meeting with your team?
items.answer: Yes, we welcome in-person or virtual meetings. Contact us to arrange a convenient time.
